shared_qualification_notes: Application method: A pre-entry placement assessment is compulsory for new students and must be completed by the applicant personally. Visit https://www.ehlanzenicollege.co.za/courses for programme details.

Eligibility explanation: NC(V) Level 2 entry is Grade 9 year-end results with Mathematics passed, or an NQF Level 1 qualification, plus the placement assessment. Report 191 N1 requires Grade 9. Report 191 N4 requires a National Senior Certificate (Grade 12) or N3.
Document checklist: Bring certified IDs, latest results, next-of-kin contact details and supporting documents as listed by the college during application.
Source note: Official Ehlanzeni TVET College courses page and published admission guidance.
